copy.curiosityHook: Under a sun that never sets, can an unraveling detective catch a killer while keeping his own deadly secret hidden?
copy.description: Investigating a homicide in northern Norway's perpetual daylight, detective Jonas accidentally kills his partner during a botched arrest, framing the runaway suspect while trying to bury his own fatal mistake.
copy.vibeSummary: Bleak, sun-bleached psychological suspense with a steady pace and heavy emotional weight, suited for focused solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Erik Skjoldbjærg trades shadowy noir for blinding midnight sun, turning a standard procedural hunt into a tense, guilt-ridden moral unraveling that offers no darkness to hide in.

allowedMaterial: Detectives Jonas and Erik arrive in northern Norway for a homicide investigation
Botched arrest leads to Jonas accidentally shooting Erik
Suspect escapes and Jonas frames the fugitive for Erik's death
Jonas hunts the killer while dealing with insomnia and guilt under the midnight sun
excludedMaterial: Identity or eventual fate of the killer
